descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S14 Existing spec: a mark and an un-mark are stored and survive a reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)
  • T1 Attendance state persists correctly per day, by server time. On the same day a mark survives a reload, navigation and other devices. The day boundary follows the server clock, not the device clock. (TFA-92587 AC 6; UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A resident created not In Today

When All Residents → '+ Today' → Today's Visits → reload → All Residents → 'In Today ✓' → Today's Visits → reload

Then The stored flag follows each tap, and Today's Visits shows or hides the resident before and after each reload

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in panels.spec.ts (snf:list inTodaysSession true / false, Today's Visits after reload). The test does not check that the un-marked resident is still in All Residents; S01 does

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S14

Existing spec: a mark and an un-mark are stored and survive a reload

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-09.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • panels.spec.ts [chromium] — an SNF resident can be added to and removed from today's visits — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright spec e2e/panels.spec.ts, chromium): it makes a fresh @roundai.test account and seeds through e2e/support with the local admin key; dev has no admin key, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
